result:
Disk full killed the api. `report-export` job filled `/var/lib/stockroom` → db couldn't write → api exited and never came back.

Timeline (all 2026-03-09):
- 03:05:00 – 03:12:48: `job=report-export` writes 40 × 512 MB CSVs (~20 GB) into `/var/lib/stockroom/exports/`, one every 12 s.
- 03:09:03: `WARN disk /var/lib/stockroom at 91%`; 03:13:30: 99%.
- 03:14:00: `ERROR db: could not extend file "base/16384/2619": No space left on device`
- 03:14:03: `ERROR api: transaction aborted, shutting down worker pool`
- 03:14:06: `FATAL api: exiting (status 1)`
- 03:16:00 – 05:28:00: `ERROR proxy: upstream api refused connection` every 2 min, 67 times.

Api still down when the log ends at 05:29:57: last api request 03:13:51, no restart line, so recovery isn't in this file. Exports share a volume with the db data dir, which is why a reporting job could take the db down.

Not the cause: `cache: slow command` WARNs (100–149 ms) run steadily from 02:00 through the whole log, before and after the crash. Proxy and web requests kept logging status=200 throughout.

Two gaps:
- Log is dated 2026-03-09, today is 2026-10-08. If "last night" was literal, this is the wrong or a stale log.
- Nothing in the repo outside `logs/` references `report-export`, so I can't say what launched it or why it wrote 20 GB.

Before restarting the api, free space in `/var/lib/stockroom/exports/`, otherwise the db hits the same error.
